title: Hypercontractivity from moment conditions
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set, let $\pi$ be a probability mass function on $\Omega$, and let $X:\Omega\to\mathbb R$. Let $r$ be a positive natural number and let $\rho\ge0$. Suppose $\mathbb E_\pi[X^2]=1$, every odd moment $\mathbb E_\pi[X^{2j-1}]$ vanishes for $1\le j\le r$, and every even moment satisfies $\mathbb E_\pi[X^{2j}]\le \frac{(2r-1)^j\binom rj}{\binom{2r}{2j}}$ for $1\le j\le r$. Then the inequality $\|a+\rho bX\|_{2r,\pi}\le\|a+bX\|_{2,\pi}$ holds for all real $a,b$ if and only if $\rho\le 1/\sqrt{2r-1}$.
hypotheses_covered: Finite sample space Ω with probability mass function π
Odd moments of orders 2j−1 vanish for every integer j from 1 through r
Even moments of orders 2j satisfy the stated binomial bound for every integer j from 1 through r
